Edit the live Deployment: `kubectl -n dojo-cks edit deploy secure-app` and add a `securityContext` at the container level under `spec.template.spec.containers[0]`.

Pod-level vs container-level: `runAsNonRoot`, `runAsUser` and `seccompProfile` can sit at pod level (`spec.template.spec.securityContext`); `readOnlyRootFilesystem`, `allowPrivilegeEscalation` and `capabilities` MUST be at the container level.

capabilities drop is a list: `capabilities: { drop: ["ALL"] }`. seccomp is `seccompProfile: { type: RuntimeDefault }`. After editing, `kubectl -n dojo-cks rollout status deploy/secure-app` to confirm it still runs.
